applicabilityBasis.summary: FIUSD is a Swiss ledger-based security representing the right to delivery of Fidelity ILF fund units, not a Sygnum deposit or the unrelated Fiserv FIUSD payment token. No payment-stablecoin authorization is asserted; the issuer-authored March 2025 application is historical and is not the definitive current bank-client contract.
